description.text:
Dragon Resurgence (龙之再临) is a three-card theme pack of Dragon Pokémon, made for the Year of the Dragon and the Dragon type's return in Nine Colours Gathering. Its cards gather Dragon Pokémon from the Sun & Moon and Sword & Shield series, some appearing for the first time in Simplified Chinese and some with new artwork, with the Supporters Raihan and Zinnia's Resolve; some of them can't be used in the Standard format. With luck a pack held Rayquaza VMAX or Duraludon VMAX in a special black and gold print.

The packs came only in gift boxes. From 1 March 2024, the Rayquaza and Ultra Necrozma art sleeve gift boxes each held one pack with 64 themed sleeves and two Nine Colours Gathering packs, and two Advanced Gift Boxes held five packs each with a binder, a rubber playmat and two 25-card Nine Colours Gathering packs. Latias & Latios and Dragonite art sleeve gift boxes followed on 17 May 2024. Every pack holds three holo cards. Its main cards are numbered out of 21; rainbow Alolan Exeggutor-GX, Kommo-o-GX and Ultra Necrozma-GX and the black and gold Rayquaza VMAX and Duraludon VMAX are numbered 022 to 026.
